videoEncoding.note: Encoded at 30fps by holding/dropping native frames using measured timestamps. No generated in-between images. Native frame gaps and readback overhead are disclosed.

audioEncoding: 320kbps AAC from original-rate stereo Master capture; float32 WAV is separately retained
limitation: Capture clocks aligned using engine timestamps and the first native video sample. Master mix/output-device latency not measured. No audible quality verdict implied. No audio normalization or video interpolation.
